Store and privately read case-scoped Support Evidence images through the shared object-storage infrastructure without exposing public asset URLs or provider metadata.

Settlement's and Commercial Terms' declared policy-console entries (definitions, read pool, write port), assembled once in the platform-api composition root so the #4291 policy console can aggregate across contexts without this context importing their domain code.

Ordering's, Fulfillment's, Settlement's, and Checkout's own support-reference lookup functions (bound to each context's own read pool), assembled once in the platform-api composition root so the #3932 unified support-reference lookup can route ORD-/SHP-/PYO-/CSG-/CS-SL- references and raw ord_/shp_/pyo_ ids without this context importing their domain code.

Pricing's platform-wide GMV/liquidity/top-catalog-item read functions, bound to pricing's own database pool and assembled once in the platform-api composition root, so the ops dashboard aggregates pricing's published Trades Tape and rollup data without this context importing pricing's domain code or querying its tables directly.

Marketplace's 0%-locked-fee listing cohort summary, Pricing's cohort-scoped GMV/weekly-trade reads, Commercial Terms' published standard fee schedule terms, and Settlement's protection-reserve summary, each bound to its owning context's database pool and assembled once in the platform-api composition root.

visibleDestination.description: Projection operation commands return live-refresh, queued-operation, or cancellation snapshots; the route action redirects to the same projection console URL so the loader refetches projection, wake, stale, lagging, partial, and unavailable states.

proof.authoritativeResponse: refreshProjectionStatus normalizes the runtime live-refresh snapshot, retry/rebuild return the enqueued operation snapshot, cancel returns the cancellation result, and the operator route preserves filters before refetching the console loader.

visibleDestination.description: Feedback submit, dismissal, review, archive, bulk status, and operator-note writes return id/version/status, snooze, or action-count snapshots; admin write forms redirect back to the filtered queue or detail route for an authoritative refetch.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Platform feedback command handlers return the committed feedback, prompt, note, or bulk action snapshot; the API maps those command results to submission, dismissal, reviewed, archived, operator-note, and bulk action responses.

visibleDestination.description: Reported content moderation actions return the recorded action id and timestamp; the detail route redirects back to the same queue item so the loader refetches the projected action status and audit fields.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Reported content action recording appends a platform-operations action event and returns the action id with recorded timestamp; the action projection updates the queue row status and latest action audit fields.

visibleDestination.description: Support request writes return lifecycle id/version/status snapshots, private attachment references, and overdue escalation counts; account routes refetch their list while operator actions keep the selected request drawer open and refetch both the deadline-ordered queue and authoritative request detail.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Support request lifecycle commands return the committed request id and aggregate version, evidence attachment upload returns the successfully persisted private references, and overdue escalation returns command-owned escalated/skipped counts; operator route actions preserve queue filters and selected request identity before the queue and drawer refetch. Remedy preview remains a command response rendered directly in the open drawer.

visibleDestination.description: The rate-limit policy create/revise routes are the shared platform-policy document commands and respond with the command-local id/version snapshot before any projection read -- no browser destination exists for this policy yet (admin UI is tracked as follow-up work), matching the checkout-processing-fee and settlement policy precedents (m110 #4286, #4287).

proof.authoritativeResponse: createRateLimitPolicyRoutes responds from the platform-policy runtime's createPolicyDocument/revisePolicyDocument command result, never from a projection read.

visibleDestination.description: Risk alert actions return the recorded action id and timestamp; the detail route redirects back to the same queue item so the loader refetches the projected action status and audit fields.

proof.authoritativeResponse: recordRiskAlertAction returns the appended action id and recorded timestamp, while the action projection owns status changes for acknowledgement and manual-payout-review-requested.

visibleDestination.description: The support-flow deadline policy create/revise routes are the shared platform-policy document commands and respond with the command-local id/version snapshot before any projection read -- no browser destination exists for this policy yet (admin UI is tracked as follow-up work), matching the settlement clearance-window/payout-bounds precedent (m110 #4287).

proof.authoritativeResponse: createSupportDeadlinePolicyRoutes responds from the platform-policy runtime's createPolicyDocument/revisePolicyDocument command result, never from a projection read.

visibleDestination.description: Policy Console confirmation returns an authoritative event-append acknowledgement, then redirects to the queue; the revision-pinned projection clears only the reviewed policy revision and a newer revision safely reopens the row.

proof.authoritativeResponse: confirm returns true only after appending a confirmation carrying the queue row's current policyRevisionEventId; the projection conditions its update on that same revision id.

visibleDestination.description: The policy console revise route (#4291) returns the command-local id/version/scheduled snapshot from the owning context's own PolicyRuntime before any projection read; the detail route redirects back to the same policy detail route, whose loader reads the same context's platform_policy_documents table directly (same database, no projection lag) for an immediate authoritative refetch.

proof.authoritativeResponse: createScheduledOrImmediateRevision returns the owning context's PolicyRuntime createPolicyDocument/revisePolicyDocument command result (documentId, version, scheduled), never from a projection read; loads go straight at platform_policy_documents via listPolicyRegistry/listActivePolicyDocuments/getPolicyDocument in the same database as the write.

projection-operations.purpose: Own projection-operations operator workflow, UI contracts, and admin console language for Platform Operations.

insights-dashboards.purpose: Own platform-operations analytical dashboard contracts, KPI projection behavior, and reporting query language: the account-scoped seller KPI queries, and the platform-wide ops dashboard (GMV/liquidity/top-catalog-items, gated by insights-dashboards.view) that aggregates pricing's published market-analytics reads via the opsMarketAnalyticsCrossContext host port plus this context's own GMV Reconciliation Run audit trail.

offer-economics.purpose: Own the offer-economics monitor (#4075, gated by insights-dashboards.view): a live-computed summary of the founders 0%-locked-fee cohort (listings created, distinct locked seller accounts, realized GMV and its share of platform GMV, a foregone-fee estimate against the published standard schedule, and a week-over-week cumulative sell-through trend) aggregated via the offerEconomicsCrossContext host port from Marketplace's listing-time fee-lock snapshot, Pricing's Trades Tape, and Commercial Terms' published standard schedule -- never mirrored into a table of its own. Order protection reserve contributions (#4098) are declared but always reported unavailable until that funding mechanism ships; this monitor is the substantiation source public campaign claims must cite (see docs/campaigns/offer-economics-claims-substantiation.md).

csat-dashboard.purpose: Own the platform-operations csat-dashboard projection-backed analytics and invitation queue read port for the platform-staff operator dashboard.

platform-feedback.purpose: Own platform-feedback behavior, read models, UI contracts, and admin review surfaces.

policy-console.purpose: Own the policy-console slice for platform-operations (#4291): lists every policy declared with definePolicy across the contexts that have migrated onto the shared platform-policy machinery, grouped by owning context, with history and scheduled-revision support. Reads query each owning context's own platform_policy_documents table directly; writes delegate to that context's own PolicyRuntime via the policyConsoleCrossContext host port.

public-doc-reviews.purpose: Own public-doc-reviews: the policy-revision-driven public article review queue, confirmation events, aging, and Policy Console attention surface.

rate-limit-policy.purpose: Own the rate-limit-policy definition (per-surface overrides, incident multiplier, kill switches) and its admin-managed create/revise API on the shared platform-policy machinery.
expectedConsumers: Checkout, Discovery, Marketplace, and Public Presence (via the rateLimitPolicyResolver host port)

reported-content.purpose: Own reported-content operator queue read models and admin moderation surfaces for Marketplace reports.

risk-alerts.purpose: Own risk-alert operator queue read models and admin Trust & Safety surfaces for account velocity signals.

support-requests.purpose: Own support-request workflow behavior, read models, API contracts, marketplace-facing support terminology, and operator queue UI.

support-reference-lookup.purpose: Own the unified support-reference lookup slice for platform-operations (#3932): routes any ORD-/SHP-/PYO-/CSG-/CS-SL- reference or raw ord_/shp_/pyo_ typed ULID (via the shared parseSupportReference primitive) to the owning context's own reference lookup and renders a support-safe summary with a link to the record. Ordering's, Fulfillment's, and Settlement's lookups plus Checkout's own CSG-/CS-SL- lookup are cross-context sources, injected via the supportReferenceLookupCrossContext host port assembled in the platform-api composition root.

request-support.purpose: Provide Platform Operations request API clients shared by platform-feedback and support-requests route modules and prompt UI.

seed-support.purpose: Provide deterministic platform-feedback and support-request seed identifiers for bootstrap and tests.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide Platform Operations event-store-backed runtime services for platform-feedback and support-request API composition.

routes.purpose: Expose platform-operations route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.

ui-support.purpose: Deployable-facing UI surface exporting the platform-feedback prompt for other contexts' marketplace routes.
